offering_description.value: FactSet sells financial data and investment software to asset managers, banks, wealth managers, and other financial institutions. It combines proprietary and third-party data and delivers it through research workstations, portfolio and trading applications, data feeds, and APIs.

primary_products.value: financial research workstations; financial and market datasets; portfolio analytics and risk software; order and execution management software; financial data feeds and APIs

primary_services.value: managed financial data operations; outsourced portfolio performance measurement and reporting; software implementation and data integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Asset managers, hedge funds, investment banks, wealth managers, asset owners, and corporate finance teams; B2G: Central banks and public investment institutions

end_markets.value: asset management; investment banking and brokerage; wealth management; institutional asset ownership; corporate finance

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to financial datasets, research workstations, portfolio analytics, and trading software

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines proprietary and third-party financial data with analytics and trading tools for investment professionals; distributor: Packages proprietary and third-party datasets for institutions to use in their own systems; service provider: Uses client holdings and transaction data to run performance measurement and reporting for investment institutions

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Financial data, investment research, portfolio analytics, trading software, and managed investment operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Institutional sales teams serving asset managers, banks, wealth managers, and other enterprise accounts; online: Web workstations, APIs, and electronic data feeds; partners / resellers: Cloud data marketplaces and third-party investment software integrations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Handling personal and client data is subject to privacy and security requirements, including the EU GDPR.

notes: It is unclear whether managed services are generally billed separately or bundled into subscriptions.
